title: Backflow certification: clarify the device, tester, and program rule
description: Certification is not a universal product label.
prompt: What does the issuing program mean by certification for this asset?
answer: Certification is not a universal product label. The issuing program defines the relevant device test, tester eligibility, due basis, and filing evidence for the specific property and assembly.
urgency: Escalate vague certification requests, unknown issuer, or a claim that a field visit alone completed the requirement.
identifiers: Identify the program, property, device, and required due basis.
Verify the credential or tester eligibility rule used by that program.
Keep the accepted result and submission evidence with the asset record.

choices.label: I have an official notice or requirement
choices.detail: Match it to the exact property and assembly before booking work.

choices.label: The device failed or needs service
choices.detail: Define repair, retest, and filing responsibility separately.

choices.label: I need a complete scope
choices.detail: Include access, testing, closeout, and documentation in the comparison.

steps.title: Map responsibility
steps.body: Read the notice or official program record before booking.

steps.body: Match the qualified tester and required test to the assembly.

steps.title: Retain the proof
steps.body: Confirm filing acceptance rather than relying on a verbal completion claim.

safeChecks: Verify asset identity and access responsibility before scheduling.
Use the official program requirement for tester and filing rules.
Keep the final record with the property or facility asset file.
stopConditions: No official program requirement can be identified.
The result cannot be matched to the correct assembly.
notThisDevice: A generic product listing is not an approval record.
A different system type may require a different workflow.
This page does not replace a qualified on-site assessment.
evidenceNote: The official program controls testing and filing; exact manufacturer records control the identified assembly service path.
